package task

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// GetTask fetches a single task by ID.
type GetTask struct {
	Tasks      repository.TaskRepository
	Structures repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

// Handle returns task by ID.
func (uc GetTask) Handle(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	return uc.Tasks.Get(ctx, taskID)
}

// HandleWithFields returns task with selected fields.
func (uc GetTask) HandleWithFields(ctx context.Context, taskID string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return uc.Tasks.GetWithFields(ctx, taskID, f)
}
